import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0039.png"))
# Pot:
mask_pot = (img[:, :, 0] > 120) & (img[:, :, 0] < 200) & (img[:, :, 1] > 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100) & (img[:, :, 2] < 60)

import subprocess
import json

# Current frame is 62. We need 18 more frames to reach 80.
# Let's inspect the sofa and north-east corner.
# Heading is 90 (facing East).
# We can turn North (-90 deg -> heading 0), move forward towards the sofa, look around, turn, etc.

actions = [
    # 63: turn towards North (turn -90), move 0.5m forward (towards y)
    {'turn_deg': -90, 'move_m': 0.5},
    # 64: look forward North, move 0.4m
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.4},
    # 65: look at sofa
    {'turn_deg': 30, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 66: look right (East)
    {'turn_deg': 60, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 67: move backward 0.3m
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': -0.3},
    # 68: turn West
    {'turn_deg': -90, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 69: move West
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.5},
    # 70: move West
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.5},
    # 71: look North
    {'turn_deg': 90, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 72: look at North wall
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.3},
    # 73: turn West (facing stool/lamp)
    {'turn_deg': -90, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 74: look at stool/lamp
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.4},
    # 75: turn South
    {'turn_deg': -90, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 76: move South
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.5},
    # 77: move South
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.5},
    # 78: look East
    {'turn_deg': -90, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 79: look East/South-East
    {'turn_deg': 30, 'move_m': 0.0},
    # 80: reach checkpoint 80
    {'turn_deg': 0, 'move_m': 0.0}
]

print(f'Total planned actions: {len(actions)}')
for i, act in enumerate(actions, 63):
    cmd = f\"python3 /app/act.py '{json.dumps(act)}'\"
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    out = res.stdout.strip()
    print(f'Frame {i}: {out}')
    if 'checkpoint' in out or i == 80:
        break
"", "description": "Execute exploration actions to reach checkpoint 80"}

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

def ground_to_world(u, v, X_cam, Y_cam, heading_deg):
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    z_cam = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    x_cam = (u - 256.0) * 1.55 / (v - 256.0)
    X_w = X_cam + z_cam * np.sin(theta) + x_cam * np.cos(theta)
    Y_w = Y_cam + z_cam * np.cos(theta) - x_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return X_w, Y_w
